description: This file defines a static class 'InaccessibleSerializableTypeDiagnostic' that contains diagnostic rules and methods for generating diagnostics related to serializable types that are inaccessible from generated code in the Orleans code generation process.

classes.name: InaccessibleSerializableTypeDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic rules and methods for checking accessibility of serializable types in source generation.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object for a given symbol indicating it is inaccessible despite being serializable.
